w:r.w:t: Full-Stack Continuation Guide — Backend Complete, Frontend In Progress

The Credit Risk Engine is a full-stack quantitative finance web application — the third tool in the karamfrm.com portfolio alongside the CORR cross-asset terminal and VaR/CVaR Tail Risk Analyzer. It models portfolio credit risk using three interconnected quantitative frameworks:
Merton Structural Model (1974) — derives implied Probability of Default (PD) from live equity data via yfinance
Vasicek One-Factor Model — simulates portfolio loss distributions via vectorized Monte Carlo (50,000 paths)
Gaussian Copula (Li, 2000) — prices CDO tranches (equity / mezzanine / senior) from the simulated loss array

Merton: Two-equation system solved numerically via scipy.optimize.fsolve. Equity as call option, Ito leverage relation. DD = [ln(V/D) + (r - 0.5*sigma_V^2)*T] / (sigma_V*sqrt(T)). PD = N(-DD).
Vasicek: A_i = sqrt(rho)*Z + sqrt(1-rho)*eps_i. Company defaults if A_i < N^(-1)(PD_i). Fully vectorized with NumPy (Z shape n_sim x 1, eps shape n_sim x n). Extracts EL, UL, CVaR, ES.
Gaussian Copula / Tranches: Tranche Loss = min(Loss, D) - min(Loss, A) per scenario. Expected tranche loss averaged across all Monte Carlo paths.
Basel II IRB: K = LGD * N[N^(-1)(PD)/sqrt(1-R) + sqrt(R/(1-R))*N^(-1)(0.999)] - LGD*PD. Used to validate Monte Carlo convergence.

Correlation slider: wrap API call in a 300ms debounce (use lodash.debounce or custom hook)
Loss histogram: use Recharts BarChart. Color each bar red if bin center > (EL + CVaR), else green. Add a ReferenceLine at EL position.
Joint default heatmap: only render when portfolio has <= 10 companies. Use D3 to draw an n x n matrix where cell (i,j) = P(company i and j both default) computed from the Monte Carlo loss array.
Backend URL: use environment variable VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 so it can be changed for production deployment.
Preset portfolios: fetch from GET /portfolio/preset/{name} (do not hardcode tickers in React — the backend already defines them).
Set environment variable in Vercel dashboard: VITE_API_URL = your backend production URL. Add vercel.json to handle React Router if used.
Python 3.13 + Anaconda: numpy/scipy/pandas must be installed via conda (not pip) due to missing C compiler. Use: conda install numpy scipy pandas -y
__init__.py files: PowerShell's '' | Out-File writes UTF-16 with null bytes. Always use [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText() to create empty files instead.
requirements.txt: version pins changed from == to >= for numpy/scipy/pandas to avoid source builds on Python 3.13.
yfinance balance sheet: quarterly data may lag up to 3 months. Total debt = shortTermDebt + longTermDebt from quarterly_balance_sheet. Falls back to info['totalDebt'] if zero.
Merton solver: uses scipy.optimize.fsolve with initial guess V0 = equity + debt, sigma_V0 = sigma_E * (equity / (equity + debt)). ier != 1 logs a warning but does not raise.
CORS: currently set to allow_origins=['*']. Restrict to karamfrm.com in production.
